handoff.salientSummary: Moved 6 integration primers into category subdirs (certificates/, ingress-controllers/, service-mesh/, gateway-api/, policy/) with byte-identical content. Added discover_integrations() to collect.py. Updated SKILL.md and workflow.md references. All 18 pytest cases pass; mypy --strict, ruff check, and ruff format all clean.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: F1.3 integration category reorg: (1) Created 5 category subdirectories under references/integrations/ and moved 6 primers into them (cert-manager.md→certificates/, traefik.md→ingress-controllers/, istio-service-mesh.md→service-mesh/, istio-ingress-gateway.md→service-mesh/, gateway-api.md→gateway-api/, opa-gatekeeper.md→policy/). (2) All primer content is byte-identical — SHA-256 hashes verified pre/post move; gateway-api.md shows as a 100%-similarity git rename. (3) Added discover_integrations(integrations_dir) to collect.py that walks category subdirs and returns {category: [primer_stem, ...]}. (4) Updated all 4 text references in SKILL.md and 3 in workflow.md to use references/integrations/<category>/<integration>.md paths. (5) Fixed pre-existing mypy strict errors in cli.py (missing type args, Any return). (6) Added 18 pytest cases covering VAL-ENGINE-011 (no top-level primers, each under correct category), VAL-ENGINE-012 (SHA-256 byte-identical), and discover_integrations() (5 tests including empty dir, flat .md, single category).
